items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: The only thing I know about him, his birthday is December the 6, same as mine. ... I do know, I’ve heard him play.

ctx.x: Dave Brubeck. The only thing I know about him, his birthday is December the 6, same as mine. Yeah, but I don’t know what year. I do know, I’ve heard him play. And he plays interesting music for sure. It’s not my style to be able to play as well as he does. And the drummers he’s had have been spectacular.
